claim_rule.safety: harmful gate replacements <= 1 and useful replacements > harmful replacements
claim_rule.strongly_supported: safety passes AND v3 minus self-refine accuracy >= 0.05 AND exact two-sided McNemar p <= 0.05
claim_rule.directionally_supported: safety passes AND v3 accuracy > self-refine accuracy but strong-support threshold is not met
claim_rule.not_supported: safety fails OR v3 accuracy <= self-refine accuracy

secondary_comparisons: v3 internal canonicalized Builder stage_vs_v3 final
post_holdout_rule: Do not tune, rewrite, or reinterpret the frozen architecture using URAI-HOLDOUT-v1 outcomes. Any future tuning requires a new development cycle and a new untouched holdout version.
